supersedes: dynamic-impact-v1 and -v1-sym cube artifacts (invalid: initial angular velocity was scaled by 0.0524)

data.source: exp-results/dynamic-impact-v1/cube-toss/contactnets_si_v2.npz (scripts/fix_contactnets_angular_velocity.py: angular velocity un-scaled, body frame, verified against finite-differenced quaternions)
data.observed_diversity: launch speed 1.0-1.35 m/s (narrow), spin 0.7-9.3 rad/s (wide), z0 0.115-0.182 m

fixed.initial_state: frame 0: position, quaternion (wxyz), world linear velocity, body angular velocity; SAP receives omega_world = R(q) omega_body (its free-joint angular velocity is world-frame), MuJoCo receives omega_body
fixed.perturbation: position + N(0,0.5 mm), orientation by rotvec N(0,0.5 deg), linear velocity + N(0,1 cm/s), body angular velocity + N(0,0.05 rad/s); identical arrays for both engines
fixed.pass_gate: finite state and no contact truncation/overflow in every rollout
fixed.loss: per trial: position RMSE (m) + 0.05 x symmetry-reduced final orientation error (rad; 24 proper cube rotations); mean over trials
fixed.mechanism_metrics: position DTW, final position error, up-face agreement, post-impact speed errors, COM rebound proxy

selection_rule: pass gate, then mean selection loss, then wall time
seed_rule: selection: seed0 + trial index (same for every candidate); held-out cell j, trial i: seed0 + 1000 + 100*j + i

candidate_rule.rationale: both span normal stiffness and dissipation. SAP v1 had ke=1e5 and ke=3e5 (identical: both on SAP's near-rigid floor); ke=3e5 is replaced by a softer ke=3e3 so the five candidates are distinct

held_out_conditions.axis: dt (1 step per 2 frames; compared on every 2nd frame)
mass, inertia scaled with mass (rigid-impact invariance; reference = real)
mass, inertia scaled with mass (rigid-impact invariance; reference = real)
orientation (rotate initial state and reference about world z; exact symmetry of a flat isotropic floor)

post_hoc_stratification.method: nominal-cell per-trial loss reported by spin tercile; no extra simulation
post_hoc_stratification.reason: substitute for a launch-speed axis: the released speeds span only 1.0-1.35 m/s

not_run_conditions.reason: no reference for altered launches; released speeds are narrow
